Nice! I like wttr but I like accu weather forecasts more....

Here, how you can get accuweather forecasts in your linux machine,

Search for your city at http://www.accuweather.com and replace the URL in the following script with the URL for your city:

!/bin/sh

URL='http://www.accuweather.com/en/de/berlin/10178/weather-forecast/178087'

wget -q -O- "$URL" | awk -F\' '/acm_RecentLocationsCarousel.push/{print $2": "$16", "$12"°" }'| head -1 Sample output:
